title: Export
description: Top-level shape for both routines.json (Drive sync) and Import/Export files (docs/SPEC.md §10). A single-routine export uses the same shape with one entry in 'routines' plus its referenced steps and trigger. One format everywhere: whatever Export produces, Import accepts.

schema_version.description: Semver. See docs/SPEC.md §4 'Schema versioning' — additive changes bump minor, breaking changes bump major.
